description: Add Famulor.io as a new automation integration in the Cal.com app store. Famulor is a no-code platform for building AI voice agents that can schedule meetings and appointments using Cal.com. This integration should follow the same redirect-based pattern as existing automation apps like Telli, providing users with a seamless way to connect their Cal.com account to Famulor's AI assistant platform.
functional_requirements: Create a new Famulor app directory in the app store with all necessary configuration files, API handlers, and static assets
Implement the redirect-based authentication flow for Famulor integration, similar to other automation apps
Update the app store utilities and generated files to include Famulor in the list of available apps
Add Famulor to the redirectApps utility to support proper redirection during the setup process
Include comprehensive documentation describing Famulor's features including AI assistant meeting booking, multi-calendar support, and language capabilities
Provide appropriate branding assets including icons and demo images for the app store listing
